name: opulent
description: Deterministic model routing: Opus (or optionally Fable) leads as architect and orchestrator; implementation, tests, and documentation are delegated to pinned Opus and Sonnet contexts, while search goes to Claude Code's built-in Explore agent and UI verification stays with the architect that designed it. Implementation is a binary choice — xhigh by default, max only for a named hazard. A hook guards the control plane and records what the main loop does — routing steered and auditable, not walled off.
